gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri has short ascenders and a tall x-height, with an a whose bowl opens up to breathe. Revalia is the one for loud, widely spaced display letters, while Noto Sans Syloti Nagri does its best work as a tidy sans underneath.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac has tall lowercase bowls like blown glass bulbs, and its s shapes turn wide and easy. Noto Sans Syriac over a stretch of text would feel friendly and modern, a plain sans moving along under Revalia's bold, loose heading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: A lowercase g with an open lower curve gives Revalia its look, set in a tall band with short stalks above. And Noto Sans Syriac Western answers with small letters packed thick with height, like bundled cable, and terminals held far from the stroke.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Revalia swaggers in with a wide, relaxed stride and a g whose lower curve stays open. Noto Sans Tagalog keeps its curves generous and lets the middle of the line carry the texture, which is the quieter job.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Revalia spaces its letters widely and leaves the g's lower curve open, which gives it a relaxed stride. And Noto Sans Tagbanwa brings clear gaps in its curves and a lowercase that fills most of the height.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Revalia strolls along with widely separated letters and a g that never quite closes its lower curve. Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its strokes out before they touch, and its capitals barely step up from the lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Expressive is Revalia's whole manner, with a tall band of letters, short stalks above, and a g left open below. And Noto Sans Tai Tham settles in beneath as sans-serif, its chalk-board lowercase crowding up toward the capital line.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet keeps short ascenders and a tall x-height, with terminals pulled back from where each curve closes. And Revalia sits over it with bold, widely spaced display letters, so the page moves from loud to approachable.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-takri: Revalia is bold and expressive, its g open below and its letters spread wide. Noto Sans Takri would read as a smooth, contemporary plain sans, every small round letter left generously unclosed beneath a high-waisted lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Revalia stretches its letters wide and leaves the g's lower curve open, a bold, relaxed look. And Noto Sans Tamil reads as if magnified, with terminals stopping far from the stem, so a long stretch stays contemporary and easy.
